title: Start the local stack and run one e2e spec

intro.answer: Docker Desktop, then supabase start, then a dev server on your own port, then one Playwright spec: three sittings, about 35 minutes the first time.
unlocks: Every end-to-end check in e2e/ can run on this PC against the local database
A change can be proved in a real browser before the integrator ships it
to_hand: The PC, signed in, with Docker Desktop installed
A PowerShell or Git Bash window at A:\Projects\Mycelium
A port of your own: 3111 here (3100 is the integrator's)

hard_part.why: the dev server compiles each page the first time it is asked for, so the first run after a fresh server can be slow or flake once. Run it a second time before judging.

basics_html: This sets up a copy of Mycelium that runs only on this computer, with its own private database, and then runs one automatic check against it. Nothing here touches the real app or its data.

phases.title: Wake the local database
phases.hard_part: Docker has to say Engine running before supabase start will work.
phases.lede_html: The local database runs inside Docker. This sitting starts Docker and then the Supabase stack.
phases.why_html: The end-to-end server points at the local stack only (e2e/support/env.ts), so nothing can reach the hosted database.
verify_html: supabase status lists an API URL of http://127.0.0.1:54321.

steps.title: Open Docker Desktop
steps.body_html: Press the Windows key, type the name below and press Enter.
steps.expect_html: The whale icon in the system tray stops moving and Docker Desktop shows Engine running at the bottom left.

troubleshooting.symptom: Docker Desktop says WSL needs updating
troubleshooting.fix: Run wsl --update in PowerShell, then open Docker Desktop again.

steps.title: Start the Supabase stack
steps.expect_html: After a minute or two it prints a table that includes API URL: http://127.0.0.1:54321 and DB URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres.

troubleshooting.symptom: It says the stack is already running
troubleshooting.fix: Nothing to do: go on to the next step.
Another copy is up. Run supabase stop, then supabase start again.

steps.title: Check the stack answers
steps.expect_html: A list that starts with DB_URL and API_URL. A line saying a few services are stopped (imgproxy, edge runtime, pooler) is normal.

steps.title: Bring the local database up to date
steps.did_html: Claude Code checks supabase migration list --local and applies any missing numbered migration with supabase db push --local --yes.

phases.title: Serve the app on your own port
phases.hard_part: Leave this window open: closing it stops the server.
phases.lede_html: A development server with the end-to-end settings: local database, every paid key blank.
phases.why_html: Each lane has its own port so two sessions never share a server (docs/run/parallel-lane.md).

steps.title: Start the end-to-end dev server

where.label: In a second shell, at A:\Projects\Mycelium

steps.expect_html: It prints Local: http://localhost:3111 and then Ready in followed by a time.

troubleshooting.fix: Something already holds the port. Pick another number above 3110, and use it in every step after this one.

steps.title: Open the health check
steps.expect_html: A short line of text that includes "ok":true. The first load can take twenty seconds while it compiles.

phases.title: Run one spec
needs: The server from sitting 2, still running
phases.hard_part: The first run after a fresh server can flake once. Run it again before judging.
phases.lede_html: One spec, as Phil: the smoke check for the Guides list page.
phases.why_html: Playwright reuses the server already answering on the port, so the run takes seconds once the page has compiled.
verify_html: The last line Playwright prints says passed.

steps.title: Run the smoke check for the Guides page

where.label: In the first shell, at A:\Projects\Mycelium

steps.expect_html: A line per check, then 1 passed and the time it took.

troubleshooting.symptom: Timed out waiting for the page
troubleshooting.fix: The page was compiling. Run the same line again.

steps.title: Write down what it said
steps.value_html: The last line Playwright printed, for example 1 passed (12.4s)
steps.expect_html: The box keeps what you typed after you click away from it.

steps.title: Delete the test report folder

where.label: In the first shell, at A:\Projects\Mycelium

steps.body_html: The reports and traces from this run are deleted for good. Skip this step if you want to look at a failure trace first.
steps.expect_html: The command prints nothing, and the folder e2e/.results is gone.

steps.title: Stop the server

where.label: The second shell, where the server runs

steps.expect_html: The shell prompt comes back. The local stack keeps running for next time.

finish_html: The local stack and an end-to-end server run on this PC, and one spec has passed against them. Any other spec runs the same way: change the file name in step 3.1.
handback_prompt: I ran the Field guide example on this PC. The spec ended with: {{result}}. Read the ticket's answers and failures with tix answers and tell me what to fix, if anything.
rollback_html: Run supabase stop to stop the stack. Its data is kept for next time.

troubleshooting.cause: The signed-in sessions were not made
troubleshooting.fix: Playwright's global setup makes them on the first run; run the spec once more.
